condition: define first N-min range after session open; optional skip if range too wide, require volume
entry: break of range high (long) / low (short): buy-stop/sell-stop beyond range or close outside
stop: opposite side of range, or range midpoint
exit: prior-day H/L, measured move, VWAP, R-multiple, or session close
evidence: trader-blog/TradingView scripts; no cited performance data
vague_flags: 'range too wide' threshold undefined; volume filter undefined
rationale: already covered by current C2 session-breakout family

entry: pull back to VWAP then resume in trend direction
data_need: session-anchored VWAP (needs reliable intraday volume + session anchor)
evidence: trader blogs; no cited performance data
rationale: needs reliable session-anchored volume/VWAP we have not validated

entry: break of flag high on rising volume
evidence: trader blogs; no cited performance data
vague_flags: flag geometry (slope, depth, duration) entirely undefined
rationale: pattern geometry too vague to code objectively

entry: break premarket/OR high after shallow pullback or inside bar
exit: R-multiple or trail; invalid if the gap fills
evidence: trader blogs; no cited performance data
rationale: FX/indices trade ~24h (no classic gap); we lack reliable catalyst/news tagging

condition: an inside bar (range contained within prior bar's range)
entry: stop order placed just beyond the inside bar high/low
stop: opposite side of the inside bar or the mother bar
exit: fixed R-multiple or trail; a gap through invalidates (fall back to ORB)
evidence: trader blogs; no cited performance data
rationale: OHLC-only, fully mechanical, no new data, distinct from current ORB/trend families

condition: trend: price above a rising 20-EMA (mirror for shorts)
entry: pull back to the EMA then break-and-hold / rejection candle
stop: beyond the EMA or last swing
evidence: trader blogs; no cited performance data

aliases: false breakout fade;failed N-bar break;stop-run reversal (Raschke)
condition: price prints a new N-bar extreme then closes back inside the range
entry: on the reversal back inside the prior extreme
exit: external target (R-multiple or prior swing) — original rules give no fixed number
evidence: Raschke write-ups / trader blogs; no cited performance data
missing_rules: exit target not specified in sources (must be parameterized + tested)
rationale: OHLC-only mechanical mean-reversion distinct from C4; missing exit is parameterizable

entry: buy-stop/sell-stop a few pips beyond the range, or a close outside it
stop: opposite side of the range, box midpoint, or fixed 0.75-1.0%
exit: R-multiple + trail, or time-exit at the London-NY overlap close; cancel unfilled by a cutoff; OCO
evidence: trader blogs / indicator listings; one uncited ~70% win-rate claim
vague_flags: buffer pips (3-5) and 'wide range skip' (>60 pips EURUSD) source-specific
rationale: session-breakout cousin of current C2; kept in reserve to avoid duplicating ORB

condition: long-only when price is above its 200-period SMA (mirror short below)
entry: RSI(2) closes below ~10 (or 5 for stricter selection)
stop: structural: exit on signal reclaim, no fixed price stop in base rules
exit: close above the 5-period SMA (or RSI(2) > 65); optional time-exit after N bars
evidence: widely published (Connors); backtests are sample-specific, book not reached
missing_rules: base rules carry no hard stop — losses structurally large (FTMO daily-loss risk)
rationale: fully mechanical, low trade count (cost-friendly); tested with an added parameterized protective stop (recorded as a deviation from the no-stop base rule); FTMO daily-loss exposure is exactly what limit-violation-rate must measure

condition: daily pivots from prior H/L/C; price interacts with a pivot level
entry: bounce off the pivot (buy near PP in uptrend); Carter: penetrate pivot + move 1/4 to next level on heavy volume
stop: a few pips beyond the pivot, or below S1 for room
exit: next pivot level (S2/R2); no new entries after 15:30 ET; stop for the day after two losers
data_need: prior-day OHLC (+ volume for the Carter variant)
evidence: broker docs / trader forums; no rigorous backtest
rationale: bounce confirmation too fuzzy for a clean first test

condition: price sweeps a prior high/low (runs resting stops) then reverses
entry: after the sweep + displacement back inside
data_need: LEVEL-2 order book / order-flow depth for true liquidity reading
evidence: trader/ICT write-ups; no cited performance data
missing_rules: true order-flow version needs L2 depth we do not capture
rationale: DATA WE LACK: true version needs order-book depth; our collector captures ticks+deals only (price-only proxy overlaps M07)
